title: CTRES v1.0 rail modules
description: Rail-module fields (§6). Each rail adds the identifiers it naturally carries. Within a module, x-ctres-req M means mandatory whenever the module applies. instrument_* definitions give the shape of R2 instrument_detail; transaction_* definitions add fields to R3 and R4; location_* and check_* definitions add fields to R1 and R5. The record schemas select a module by the value of rail (or location_type, or check_type).

instrument_card.description: Card module: instrument_detail for rail card (§6). The card number itself is never carried.

bin.description: Bank identification number: the first six to eight digits of the card number (§6).

last_four.description: Last four digits of the card number (§6).

card_token.description: Tokenised card number issued by the provider or a token service (§6).

instrument_bank_transfer.description: Bank transfer and instant payments module: instrument_detail for rail bank_transfer (§6).

account_number_masked.description: Masked account number; masked characters are written as * (§4.2; §6; §12).

scheme.description: Scheme or system used, as a snake_case code, for example sepa_inst, pix, ted, interac, cbu_cvu or eft (§6).

instant_payment_key_type.description: Type of instant-payment key or alias used to address the account, as a snake_case code, for example national_id, email, phone or random_key (§4.2; §6).
instant_payment_key_type.x-ctres-condition: Where the account is addressed through an instant-payment key or alias (§6).

instrument_emoney.description: E-money and e-wallet module: instrument_detail for rail emoney (§6).

wallet_account_id_masked.description: Masked wallet account identifier; masked characters are written as * (§6; §12).

funding_source_type.description: Type of source that funds the e-wallet, where the provider discloses it (§6).

instrument_mobile_money.description: Mobile money and carrier billing module: instrument_detail for rails mobile_money and carrier_billing (§6).

phone_number_hash.description: Hashed phone number, as hexadecimal digest; the phone number itself is never carried (§4.2; §6; §12).

mobile_operator_id.description: The mobile network operator, as a provider_id in R10 (§6; §4.10).

instrument_voucher.description: Vouchers and prepaid module: instrument_detail for rail voucher (§6). The holder is established at redemption.

voucher_issuer_id.description: The voucher issuer, as a provider_id in R10 (§6; §4.10).

instrument_cash.description: Cash at retail or venue module: instrument_detail for rail cash (§6).

retail_point_id.description: Retail point, point of sale or cage at which cash is accepted or paid (§6).

instrument_virtual_asset.description: Virtual-asset module: instrument_detail for rail virtual_asset (§6). The link between an address and a player is personal data (§12).

chain.description: Network on which the address exists, as a snake_case code, for example ethereum or tron (§6; §8.2).

address.description: Wallet address linked to the player (§4.2; §6).

unique_deposit_address.description: Whether the operator allocated this deposit address to this player alone, which makes attribution direct (§6; Curaçao edition R2).

link_source.description: How the link became known (§6; Curaçao edition R2).

transaction_virtual_asset.description: Virtual-asset module: fields added to R3 and R4 where rail is virtual_asset (§6; Curaçao edition R3/R4).

chain.description: Network on which the payment was made, as a snake_case code (§6; §8.2).

off_chain_movement.description: True where the movement happened inside a provider's books and has no transaction on chain (§6 off-chain flag).

block_time.description: Time of the block that included the transaction (§6).

confirmations.description: Number of confirmations at crediting or dispatch (§6).

counterparty_address.description: The player's address for a deposit, or the destination address for a withdrawal (§6).

counterparty_type.description: Type of the counterparty address (§6 counterparty type).

transaction_cash.description: Cash at retail or venue module: fields added to R3 and R4 where rail is cash (§6). The receipt is carried in rail_reference.

cashier_ref.description: Pseudonymous reference of the cashier who handled the cash (§6).

transaction_voucher.description: Vouchers and prepaid module: fields added to R3 and R4 where rail is voucher (§6). The voucher serial is carried in rail_reference and the issuer in provider_id.

retail_point_id.description: Point of sale at which the voucher was sold (§6).

location_virtual_asset.description: Virtual-asset module: fields added to R1 where location_type is crypto_wallet (§6: wallet temperature and key-control models carried forward from the Curaçao edition).

chain.description: Network on which the wallet is held, as a snake_case code (§6).

key_control_model.description: How the keys are controlled (§6; Curaçao edition R1).

approvers.description: Roles authorised to move funds from the wallet (§6; Curaçao edition R1).
approvers.x-ctres-condition: Where temperature is warm or cold (Curaçao edition R1).

check_virtual_asset.description: Virtual-asset module: fields added to R5 where check_type is blockchain_analytics (§6; Curaçao edition R5).

exposure_categories.description: Exposure categories reported by the analytics provider (§6; Curaçao edition R5).
